# Steps

One section per `action:` a flow can write. Every step also takes the targeting fields and the shared options at the end.

## `check`

Drive a checkbox or radio to a state, whatever state it is already in.

| field | type | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `checked` | `bool` | `True` | The state to leave the control in. |


## `click`

A real pointer click, hit-tested: a click that lands on an overlay fails
instead of silently activating it.

| field | type | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dispatch` | `bool` | `False` | Fire the DOM event directly, for an element no pointer can reach. |
| `humanize` | `bool \| None` | `None` | Override the run's humanization for this step alone. |


## `dom`

Return the matched element's HTML, sanitized — for reading a structure
no `read` has a shape for yet.

| field | type | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `max_depth` | `int` | `0` | Depth to truncate the tree at; 0 keeps it whole. |
| `level` | `SanitizeLevel` | `'low'` | How much noise to strip before returning the HTML. |
| `path` | `str \| None` | `None` | Where `llm-browser run` writes the HTML, under `--out-dir`. |


## `download`

Click `selector` and keep what the browser downloaded, in memory; like
`screenshot`, `path` is an instruction to `llm-browser run` alone.

| field | type | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `str \| None` | `None` | Where `llm-browser run` writes the file, under `--out-dir`; unset uses the name the server suggested. |


## `eval`

Step with no browser action (eval-only, wait).

## `fill`

Set an input's value in one go; `type` is the per-key alternative for a
field that listens to keystrokes.

| field | type | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `str` | `''` | Text to put in the field. |
| `humanize` | `bool \| None` | `None` | Override the run's humanization for this step alone. |


## `goto`

Navigate. Only http(s) and about:blank are allowed — a flow cannot be
talked into reading `file:` off the machine it runs on.

| field | type | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | `str` | `required` | Where to navigate. |
| `wait_until` | `str` | `'domcontentloaded'` | Load milestone to wait for: `domcontentloaded`, `load` or `networkidle`. |


## `parse`

Read rows like `read`, then validate each one against a YAML schema
and hand back typed instances rather than strings.

| field | type | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `schema_path` | `str` | `required` | YAML schema every row is validated against; CWD-relative or absolute. |
| `path` | `str \| None` | `None` | Where `llm-browser run` writes the rows, under `--out-dir`. |


## `pick`

Click the one match whose text is `value` — the custom-dropdown
counterpart to `select`, so the selector names the whole option list.

| field | type | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `str` | `''` | Text of the option to click. |


## `press`

Send a key or a chord; the one step that needs no selector.

| field | type | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selector` | `Selector \| None` | `None` | Element to press on; unset presses whatever has focus. |
| `key` | `str` | `required` | Key or chord, e.g. `Enter` or `Control+a`. |


## `read`

Pull text out of the matched elements as rows of named fields — the
selector names the row, `extract` names the columns.

| field | type | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `extract` | `dict[str, ExtractField]` | `—` | Field name to `child selector@attribute`; unset reads each row's own text as `text`. |
| `exclude` | `list[str]` | `[]` | CSS selectors whose text is dropped from the read, on a copy of the DOM. |
| `path` | `str \| None` | `None` | Where `llm-browser run` writes the rows, under `--out-dir`. |
| `save_as` | `SaveAs \| None` | `None` | Put the rows, or one field of one row, into flow data for later steps. |


## `run-flow`

Compose another flow inline as a single step.

`flow` is the child flow itself. A reference string is inlined by
`resolve_flow` before validation, so an
unresolved reference is a validation error.

Sub-flows are leaf-only: a child may not itself contain `run-flow`
steps — `SubFlow`'s validator enforces that.

| field | type | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `flow` | `SubFlow \| str` | `required` | The child flow inline, or a reference resolved before validation. |
| `data` | `dict[str, Any]` | `{}` | Params handed to the child flow. |


## `screenshot`

Capture the page as PNG bytes in `outputs`; the library never writes a
file, so `path` is an instruction to `llm-browser run` alone.

| field | type | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `str \| None` | `None` | Where `llm-browser run` writes the PNG, under `--out-dir`. |
| `selector` | `Selector \| None` | `None` | Crop to this element; unset captures the viewport. |


## `scroll`

Mouse-wheel scroll: `times` ticks of `delta` px, paced by `pause`.

| field | type | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `delta` | `int` | `600` | Pixels per tick; negative scrolls up. |
| `times` | `int` | `1` | How many ticks. |
| `pause` | `Jitter` | `Jitter(min_ms=300, max_ms=1200)` | Gap between ticks in ms. |


## `select`

Choose an option on a native `<select>`; a custom widget is a `click`
then a `pick`.

| field | type | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `str` | `''` | Option to choose, matched on its value, label or text. |


## `think`

Pause for a random spell, so a run does not act at machine cadence.

| field | type | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `min_ms` | `int` | `500` | Shortest pause in ms. |
| `max_ms` | `int` | `2000` | Longest pause in ms. |


## `type`

Type key by key, so a field that reacts to each keystroke (autocomplete,
a masked input) sees them.

| field | type | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `str` | `''` | Text to type. |
| `delay` | `int \| Jitter` | `0` | Per-key gap in ms, or `[min, max]` to jitter it — a constant cadence is itself a fingerprint. |
| `humanize` | `bool \| None` | `None` | Override the run's humanization for this step alone. |


## `wait_for`

Poll until `selector` reaches `state`, or fail the step.

The one wait: four states answer "is the element there yet" and `stable`
answers "has its text stopped changing" — for streaming content (LLM chat
replies, progressive lists, a recalculating total). `timeout` is the
whole budget; `interval` is the nominal gap between polls, jittered;
`settle` is how long the text has to hold still, and applies to
`stable` only.

`text` waits on the page's rendered text instead — a landmark a selector
cannot name — scoped to `selector` when both are given, substring unless
`exact`.

| field | type | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selector` | `Selector \| None` | `None` | Element to watch; scopes `text` when both are given. |
| `text` | `str \| None` | `None` | Rendered text to wait for — a landmark no selector names. |
| `exact` | `bool` | `False` | Match the whole text rather than a substring. |
| `state` | `"attached" \| "detached" \| "visible" \| "hidden" \| "enabled" \| "disabled" \| "stable"` | `'attached'` | The state to wait for. |
| `interval` | `int` | `500` | Nominal gap between polls in ms, jittered. |
| `settle` | `int` | `1500` | How long the text must hold still for state `stable`; must be under `timeout`. |


## Targeting

Every step that acts on an element takes these; a step that redeclares one says so in its own table.

| field | type | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selector` | `Selector` | `required` | What the step acts on: a CSS string, a selector form, or a `ref:`. |
| `expect` | `int \| "many" \| None` | `None` | How many elements the selector should match; the default follows the action. |
| `pick` | `"first" \| "last" \| int \| None` | `None` | Which match to act on when there is more than one: `first`, `last` or a 0-based index. |

## Shared options

Common fields shared by all step types.

No `selector` here — see `SelectorStep` for steps that target a DOM
element. Goto / wait / screenshot / think / eval-only steps inherit
`BaseStep` directly.

`scope` is written `in:` in a flow (`in` is a keyword): it names the
enclosing repeat's `as` and scopes this step's selector to that pass's
element, descendants only.

| field | type | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `str` | `'unnamed'` | Identifies the step: keys its output, targets `--from` and a retry hint. |
| `in` | `str \| None` | `None` | Written `in:`; names the enclosing repeat's `as` and confines this step's selector to that pass's element. |
| `fields` | `list[TargetSpec]` | `[]` | Element targets carried for a host to act on; the runner does not execute them. |
| `read` | `dict[str, TargetSpec]` | `{}` | Named element targets carried for a host to act on; the runner does not execute them. |
| `when` | `list[dict[str, Any]]` | `[]` | Conditions that must all hold, or the step is skipped rather than failed. |
| `eval` | `str \| None` | `None` | Expression evaluated after the action; its value lands in flow data. |
| `wait_after` | `int \| None` | `None` | Idle pause in ms after the step, for a page that settles late. |
| `optional` | `bool` | `False` | A timeout or bad value skips the step instead of failing the flow. |
| `timeout` | `int` | `10000` | Budget in ms for this step's action, waits included. |
| `repeat` | `Repeat \| None` | `None` | Run this step once per element or per list item. |
